defect.mechanism: execute() assigns gold at line 190 as gold_action = strict_action(c), then computes the candidate prediction at line 201 as strict_action(c) — the same pure function on the same argument. strict_action reads only the boolean decision coordinates and never the rng-derived confidence, so the two calls are identical by construction.
defect.consequence: exact_action_accuracy = mean(f(c) == f(c)) is identically 1.0; unsafe_apply_rate identically 0.0; cannot_check_recall and legitimate_apply_recall identically 1.0. Four of the six registered hard-gate conditions cannot fail for any case set the generator can emit.
defect.sibling_finding: Paper II six-family gate (PR #612) — same class, different mechanism (gold-bound arm rather than literal self-identity).

controls_asserted_before_probing.why_this_matters: The two live conditions move under the identical perturbation set, so the four INSENSITIVE verdicts are not a broken-probe artifact. A battery that returned NON_FALSIFIABLE for everything would catch this and be useless; one that returned FALSIFIABLE for everything would be worse, because it would read as reassurance.
controls_asserted_before_probing.independent_historical_corroboration: research/paper3_publication_validation_v2/PROTOCOL_FREEZE.json :: parent_v1_terminal = INSTRUMENT_DEFECT_TWO_MUTATIONS_NOT_EXERCISED — the mutation arm has a recorded real-world failure, which is stronger evidence of liveness than any probe.

what_the_receipt_still_supports.retained_claim: On a generated 14-family / 1792-case structured-state benchmark, the registered typed experience coordinates are information-sufficient to determine the governed action, while five named simpler projections provably are not: COMPOSITE_SIMPLE_PARENT reaches a deterministic information ceiling of 0.714 with unsafe_apply_rate 0.286 and cannot_check_recall 0.0.
what_the_receipt_still_supports.why_this_survives: The parent information ceilings are computed by grouping cases on each parent's visible field subset and taking the majority gold label. That is a correctly-computed property of the projection, not a score attributed to a candidate. It is falsifiable — it moves from 0.667 to 0.996 under perturbation — and the 0.286 unsafe rate and 0.0 CANNOT_CHECK recall of the composite parent are real measurements of what those projections erase.
what_the_receipt_still_supports.role_of_the_1.0: The typed arm's 1.0 is the correct reference ceiling for a deterministic function of the full coordinate set. It is not evidence of candidate skill and must never be reported as accuracy.

what_the_receipt_does_not_support: any accuracy, safety-rate, recall or fidelity claim about the typed router as a measured candidate
'the typed router achieved 100% exact action accuracy' or any equivalent phrasing
'unsafe apply rate was 0.0' as an empirical safety result
'CANNOT_CHECK recall was 1.0' as a measured competence
any comparison in which the typed arm's 1.0 is treated as an outcome rather than a definition

repair_proposed_not_executed.reason: Repairing the harness would create a new gate requiring a fresh freeze and a fresh confirmatory budget. Executing it here and presenting new numbers would breach the freeze-before-outcome-access rule. The repair is proposed; it is deliberately not run.
repair_proposed_not_executed.minimum_repair: The gold label must not be produced by the candidate. Either (a) assign gold from the generator's construction intent as an independent field written by make_pair, and then verify that strict_action's disagreement with it is a measurable quantity; or (b) drop the four typed metrics from the hard gate entirely and register the benchmark as what it validly is — a projection-lossiness / information-sufficiency instrument whose gate is composite_residual plus all_mutations_caught.
repair_proposed_not_executed.preferred: (b) is honest immediately and requires no new generator; (a) is required before any accuracy-shaped claim.
repair_proposed_not_executed.warning_on_(a): Writing gold from the perturbation identity is itself disqualifying under research/paper3/PAPER3_TRACK_A_REGISTRATION_V1.md §2.1. An independent verifier, not the generator's intent, must assign the label.
